title: Treatment with Risedronate for dilated cardiomyopathy due to Troponin T alteration due to K210 deletion.
official: Treatment with Risedronate for dilated cardiomyopathy due to Troponin T alteration due to K210 deletion.
summary: Main objective: To study whether the administration of Risedronate 10 mg/day in patients with dilated cardiomyopathy due to K210 deletion mutation in the Troponin T gene is associated with: A change in left ventricular function, measured by Echocardiogram

interventions.name: Actonel 5 mg comprimidos recubiertos con película

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Older than 18 years old
2. Dilated cardiomyopathy due to K210 deletion mutation in the Troponin T gene
3. LVEF ≤ 50%
4. Patients who have given written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. Hypersensitivity to Risedronate
2. Hypocalcemia
3. Severe renal failure (eGFR < 30 ml/min/1.73m2)
4. History of esophageal disorders, with delay in transit or esophageal emptying, due to  example, stenosis or achalasia
5. Barrett's esophagus
6. Inability to remain upright for at least 30 minutes after taking of the tablet.
7. Active treatment with corticosteroids or chemotherapy
8. Pregnant or breastfeeding women
9. Use of other investigational drugs at the time of inclusion, or during the  30 days prior to inclusion
sponsor: Fundacion Para La Formacion E Investigacion Sanitaria De La Region De Murcia
